plan_scope: Exploratory native sessions in one originally authorized included-usage window
allocation: The first 84 factorial calls and the first 56 caption calls provided complete balanced cohorts. After observing the first eight caption blocks, the investigators scheduled a fresh selection-disclosure comparison on those blocks, then prioritized a second unmodified caption wave before the remaining factorial assignments. Within-study orders and endpoints were fixed before their own collection. Competitors for the shared access window included the independently frozen CPython repeats, Matplotlib repeats and definition-omission study. The account counters do not attribute utilization to any one researcher or task.
